scripts.deploy:api: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply logue-db --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.toml && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:web: echo VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://logue-api.anison.workers.dev > apps/web/.env.production && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name logue-web
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:web
